x402-foundation/x402#3220.title: Add `authority` extension: bounded, offline-verifiable spending mandates

last_comment.author: Fizzl13
last_comment.text:
We implemented the single-payment part of this draft (§6, §7) in presign-guard, a pre-sign check for agent payments:

- POST /v1/check takes an optional mandate next to an EIP-3009 signature and turns a payment outside it red before the agent signs (wrong payer/asset/recipient, over perPayment or cap, expired, bad issuer signature, nonce ≠ binding).
- presign-guard-wallet's mandatePayer() makes x402 payments with the §7 binding as the EIP-3009 nonce.
- JCS bytes, digest, signature and the EIP-3009/Permit2 binding values match authority-vectors.json byte for byte.

Not covered: cumulative spend
